description.zh: 监视指定提供商：回合因重试耗尽（超时/连接中断/空响应等）异常结束时自动续跑；连续失败达到阈值后切到备用模型（思考强度由你为每条备用显式选定）。自带配置面板与事件日志。
description.en: Watches selected providers: automatically resumes a turn that ended on a retry-exhausted failure (timeout, transport, empty response). After the consecutive-failure threshold it switches to your fallback models with an explicitly chosen reasoning effort. Ships a config panel and an event log.
